subproblem.title: Deformation of a compactly supported IM current with IM boundary onto the n-skeleton (Simon 6.5.1, displays (6)–(25))
subproblem.statement: Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d (smooth d-forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in U) and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d; ∂X = X.boundary (∂X(ω) = X(dω)); X − Y is the contract subtraction (pointwise on test forms). For G ⊆ ℝ^P, M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of max(X(ω), 0) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, where |·| is the Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors (covectorEuclideanNorm); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U is the contract structure IMRep U d; R represents X when X(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHᵈ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U), where ⟨ω, ξ⟩(x) = ξ(x)(ω(x)); μ_R = θ·Hᵈ⌞M is R.measure and R.action(β) = ∫_M θ ξ(β) dHᵈ for any d-form β; X is integer multiplicity (IM, IsIntegerMultiplicity X) if some IMRep represents it. X vanishes off a set E if X(ω) = 0 for every ω whose tsupport is disjoint from E. Assume (SL) the exact frozen statement of dor_lmb_slicing_lipschitz (the antecedent of the parent statement dor_lmb_fc_deformation), taken as an antecedent: assuming (C1) [for open U, X ∈ 𝒟_d(U) and an IMRep R in U representing X: M_W(X) = μ_R(W) for every open W and spt X = U ∩ spt μ_R], for every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) represented by an IMRep RT = (M, θ, ξ), every IMRep RB = (M', θ', ξ') representing ∂T and every L-Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, there are P_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) such that (1) for every open W, t ↦ M_W(P_t) is a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ M_W(P_t) dt ≤ L·M_W(T); (2) for L¹-a.e. t: P_t is IM, P_t(ω) = 0 for every ω whose tsupport is disjoint from f⁻¹(t), and P_t(ω) = ∫_{M∩{f<t}} θ⟨dω, ξ⟩ dH^{k+1} − ∫_{M'∩{f<t}} θ'⟨ω, ξ'⟩ dH^k for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Assume (IMS) the exact frozen statement of dor_lmb_fc_im_series (a resolved dependency of the parent node, not yet accepted, hence taken as an antecedent): for all P, m, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and IM currents X_r ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) (r ∈ ℕ) with Σ_r M(X_r) ≠ ∞ there is an IM Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) with Σ_r X_r(ω) = Y(ω) (HasSum) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(U) and M(Y) ≤ Σ_r M(X_r). Let P, m ∈ ℕ with n := m + 1 < P. There is c ≥ 0 such that for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P and every IM T ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (domain univ) with ∂T IM, T vanishing off K, M(T) ≠ ∞ and M(∂T) ≠ ∞, there are IM currents Q ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), R₁ ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P), S₁ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with: T(ω) − Q(ω) = ∂R₁(ω) + S₁(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P); M(Q) ≤ cM(T), M(∂Q) ≤ cM(∂T), M(R₁) ≤ cM(T), M(S₁) ≤ cM(∂T) (in [0, ∞], c via ENNReal.ofReal); Q vanishes off L_n ∩ cthickening(√P, K), where L_n := {x : there is a finset s of coordinate indices with P ≤ m + 1 + |s| and x_i ∈ ℤ for i ∈ s} (the n-skeleton of the unit cubical grid); and R₁ and S₁ vanish off cthickening(√P, K).
subproblem.lean_statement: ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) ∧ T.support = U ∩ R.measure.support) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (RT : IMRep U (n + 1)) (RB : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → RT.Represents T → RB.Represents T.boundary → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ Ps : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → AEMeasurable (fun t => (Ps t).massOn W) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (Ps t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * T.massOn W) ∧ ∀ᵐ t, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ps t) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) (f ⁻¹' {t}) → Ps t ω = 0) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Ps t ω = (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → (∀ r, IsIntegerMultiplicity (X r)) → ∑' r, (X r).mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), HasSum (fun r => X r ω) (Y ω)) ∧ Y.mass ≤ ∑' r, (X r).mass) → ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsCompact K → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T.boundary → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) (K) → T ω = 0) → T.mass ≠ ∞ → T.boundary.mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ (Q : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (R₁ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S₁ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity Q ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity R₁ ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S₁ ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), T ω - Q ω = R₁.boundary ω + S₁ ω) ∧ Q.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * T.mass ∧ Q.boundary.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * T.boundary.mass ∧ R₁.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * T.mass ∧ S₁.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * T.boundary.mass ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) ({x : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + 1 + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, x i = z} ∩ cthickening (Real.sqrt P) K) → Q ω = 0) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 2))) (cthickening (Real.sqrt P) K) → R₁ ω = 0) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) (cthickening (Real.sqrt P) K) → S₁ ω = 0
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: Simon Ch. 6, proof of the Deformation Theorem 5.1, displays (6)–(25) (chapter-06.txt, from the choice of a and (8) up to (25)), as written in steps 3–6 of the parent proof. Dependencies: GC = sibling dor_lmb_fcd_good_center (displays (1)–(7)); RET = sibling dor_lmb_fcd_retraction (Lemma 5.4, corrected); PF = sibling dor_lmb_fcd_pushforward_homotopy (the operators ψ_#, h_#([[(0,1)]] × ·) of 2.23–2.29 with the homotopy formula 2.25, the mass bound 2.27 and integrality 3.9), applied to the antecedent (IMS); (C1) = reused sibling dor_imrep_massOn_eq_measure_and_support; (IMC) = reused sibling cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub; (SL) and (IMS) = the antecedents of the statement. Differences from the parent text: (i) the parent's X_k = T − T_{σ̃_k} are decomposed into the dyadic shells already used in its step 5 (X_{k+1} − X_k), each deformed with its own globally Lipschitz extension of ψ (PF works with globally Lipschitz maps; it depends only on the values on a compact set off which the current vanishes); (ii) the limits Q, R₁, S₁ are the IM sums given by (IMS) of the shell contributions, as in the parent's step 5; (iii) only the T-slices of (SL) are needed (every pushed current is IM, so PF needs no boundary-mass bound on the ∂T-pieces).

Notation. n := m + 1 < P. All currents are on univ. “X vanishes off E” means X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ∩ E = ∅; this is inherited by larger sets E, differences and weak limits. For currents A, B, “A + B” abbreviates A − (0 − B) (the contract subtraction is pointwise; currents with equal values are equal, GeometricCurrentOn.ext). L_n := {x : at least P − n coordinates are integers} (closed). Let K be compact, T IM with ∂T IM, T vanishing off K, M(T), M(∂T) < ∞. ∂T also vanishes off K (∂T(ω) = T(dω), tsupport dω ⊆ tsupport ω).

1. Constants and trivial case. Let c_R > 0 be RET's constant and C_G := GC's constant + 1 (> 0) for (P, m); c₄ := 8(1 + √P c_R) and
 c := max(1, c₄ⁿ(1 + 2C_G), √P(2c₄)ⁿ(1 + 2C_G), √P(2c₄)^{n−1}(1 + 2C_G), c₄^{n−1}(1 + 2C_G)) ≥ 0,
 which depends only on P and m. Let (push, homot) be PF's operators for this P. The zero current of any degree is IM (empty carrier, multiplicity 0, orientation 0; ∅ is Borel and countably rectifiable by SimonGMT countablyRectifiable_of_measure_zero). If M(T) = 0 then T = 0 (|T(ω)| ≤ M(T)·sup|ω| after scaling ω to be admissible) and ∂T = 0, and Q = R₁ = S₁ := 0 satisfy all conclusions. Assume M(T) > 0.

2. Measures (parent step 0). Let R_T = (M, θ, ξ) represent T and R_∂ = (M', θ', ξ') represent ∂T; μ_T := R_T.measure, μ_∂ := R_∂.measure. By (C1), μ_T(W) = M_W(T) and μ_∂(W) = M_W(∂T) for open W. Hence μ_T(ℝ^P) = M(T) < ∞, μ_∂(ℝ^P) = M(∂T) < ∞, and μ_T(ℝ^P ∖ K) = μ_∂(ℝ^P ∖ K) = 0 (every admissible form for the open set ℝ^P ∖ K has tsupport disjoint from K); as θ, θ' ≥ 1, Hⁿ(M ∖ K) = H^{n−1}(M' ∖ K) = 0. For a Borel set B, (IMC)(b) gives a current T⌞B represented by (M ∩ B, θ, ξ), so (T⌞B)(ω) = ∫_{M∩B}θξ(ω) dHⁿ, μ_{T⌞B} = μ_T⌞B, M(T⌞B) = μ_T(B) by (C1), and T⌞B vanishes off K ∩ closure(B) (the integrand vanishes on M ∩ B ∩ K when ω vanishes on K ∩ closure B, and M ∖ K is null); likewise (∂T)⌞B. These restrictions are IM.

3. Good centre and retraction (Simon (1)–(7), Lemma 5.4). GC applied to the finite measures μ_T, μ_∂ gives a with |a_i − 1/2| < 1/4 such that, with L*(a) := {w : w_i − a_i ∈ ℤ for at least n + 1 indices} and d := infDist(·, L*(a)) (1-Lipschitz, Mathlib Metric.lipschitz_infDist_pt),
 (6) μ_T({d < r}) ≤ C_G r^{n+1}M(T), (7) μ_∂({d < r}) ≤ C_G r^{n+1}M(∂T) for r ∈ (0, 1/4].
 RET with this a gives ψ with: if d(x) > 0 then ψ(x) ∈ L_n and |ψ(x) − x| ≤ √P; and ψ is (c_R/r)-Lipschitz on {d ≥ r} for r ∈ (0, 1/4]. For r ∈ (0, 1/4] let φ_r : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be the componentwise McShane extension of ψ|{d ≥ r} (Mathlib LipschitzOnWith.extend_real applied to each coordinate x ↦ ψ(x)_i, which is (c_R/r)-Lipschitz on {d ≥ r}); φ_r is (√P c_R/r)-Lipschitz and φ_r = ψ on {d ≥ r}. Put Λ(r) := max(1, √P c_R/r) ∈ ℝ≥0; id and φ_r are Λ(r)-Lipschitz, and Λ(r) ≤ c₄2^j whenever r ≥ 2^{−j−3}.

4. Slices and good radii (Simon (8)–(10), 4.10; parent step 3). Apply (SL) — its antecedent (C1) is the reused sibling — with U := univ, its degree index := m (so T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}), RT := R_T, RB := R_∂, f := d and L := 1. This gives P_t ∈ 𝒟_m (t ∈ ℝ) with: (SL1) for every open W, t ↦ M_W(P_t) is a.e.-measurable and ∫⁻ M_W(P_t) dt ≤ M_W(T) = μ_T(W); (SL2) for a.e. t: P_t is IM, P_t vanishes off d⁻¹(t), and P_t(ω) = ∫_{M∩{d<t}}θξ(dω) dHⁿ − ∫_{M'∩{d<t}}θ'ξ'(ω) dH^m. Writing A_t := T⌞{d < t} and B_t := (∂T)⌞{d < t} (step 2), (SL2) says P_t = ∂A_t − B_t for a.e. t.
 For ν ≥ 0 let ρ_ν := 2^{−ν−2} and W_ν := {ρ_ν/2 < d < ρ_ν} (open). For t ∈ (ρ_ν/2, ρ_ν) in the a.e. set of (SL2): M(P_t) ≤ M_{W_ν}(P_t). Indeed, for an admissible ω, C := d⁻¹(t) ∩ tsupport ω is a compact subset of the open set W_ν; take χ ∈ C^∞, 0 ≤ χ ≤ 1, equal to 1 on a neighbourhood of C, with compact tsupport χ ⊆ W_ν (smooth Urysohn). Then (1 − χ)ω has tsupport disjoint from d⁻¹(t), so P_t((1 − χ)ω) = 0, and χω is admissible for W_ν, so P_t(ω) = P_t(χω).
 By (SL1) with W := W_ν, (C1) and (6): ∫⁻_{(ρ_ν/2, ρ_ν)} M_{W_ν}(P_t) dt ≤ μ_T(W_ν) ≤ C_Gρ_ν^{n+1}M(T). By Markov's inequality (a.e.-measurability from (SL1)), the set of t ∈ (ρ_ν/2, ρ_ν) with M_{W_ν}(P_t) > 4C_Gρ_νⁿM(T) has measure ≤ ρ_ν/4 < ρ_ν/2. So there is r_ν ∈ (ρ_ν/2, ρ_ν) in the a.e. set of (SL2) with
 (10) M(P_{r_ν}) ≤ 4C_Gρ_νⁿM(T).
 Write Z_ν := P_{r_ν} (IM, vanishing off d⁻¹(r_ν)) and A_ν := A_{r_ν}, B_ν := B_{r_ν}; so ∂A_ν = B_ν + Z_ν. The r_ν strictly decrease to 0 (r_{ν+1} < ρ_ν/2 < r_ν), r_ν ≤ 1/4 and r_ν > 2^{−ν−3}.

5. The shells (parent step 5). For j ≥ 0 let E_j := K ∩ {d ≥ r_j} (compact) and
 W_0 := T − A_0, W_j := A_{j−1} − A_j (j ≥ 1); D_0 := ∂T − B_0, D_j := B_{j−1} − B_j (j ≥ 1).
 (a) W_j = T⌞S_j and D_j = (∂T)⌞S_j with S_0 := {d ≥ r_0}, S_j := {r_j ≤ d < r_{j−1}} (additivity of the integrals of step 2); so W_j, D_j are IM (also by (IMC)(c)), vanish off K ∩ closure(S_j) ⊆ E_j, M(W_0) ≤ M(T), M(D_0) ≤ M(∂T), and for j ≥ 1, by (6), (7) and S_j ⊆ {d < r_{j−1}} ⊆ {d < ρ_{j−1}}: M(W_j) ≤ C_G2^{−(j+1)(n+1)}M(T), M(D_j) ≤ C_G2^{−(j+1)(n+1)}M(∂T).
 (b) Boundaries: ∂W_0 = ∂T − B_0 − Z_0 = D_0 − Z_0 and ∂W_j = (B_{j−1} + Z_{j−1}) − (B_j + Z_j) = D_j + Z_{j−1} − Z_j (j ≥ 1). These are IM ((IMC)(c), sums and differences of IM currents).
 (c) Z_j vanishes off E_j: Z_0 = D_0 − ∂W_0 and Z_j = D_j + Z_{j−1} − ∂W_j, where W_j, D_j vanish off E_j (so ∂W_j does), and by induction Z_{j−1} vanishes off E_{j−1} ⊆ E_j.
 (d) Σ_{j=0}^{N} W_j = T − A_N, and M(A_N) = μ_T({d < r_N}) ≤ C_Gρ_N^{n+1}M(T) → 0.

6. Deforming the shells (Simon (11)–(20)). For j ≥ 0 let φ_j := φ_{r_j} and Λ_j := Λ(r_j) ≤ c₄2^j; Λ_j ≤ Λ_{j+1}. Then φ_j = ψ on E_j ⊆ {d ≥ r_j}, and φ_{j+1} = φ_j = ψ on E_j. Define (degrees: V_j, W_j ∈ 𝒟_n; H_j ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}; Y_j, L_j ∈ 𝒟_{n−1}; E'_j, K_j ∈ 𝒟_n)
 V_j := push n φ_j W_j, H_j := homot n id φ_j W_j, Y_j := push (n−1) φ_j D_j, E'_j := homot (n−1) id φ_j D_j, L_j := push (n−1) φ_j Z_j, K_j := homot (n−1) id φ_j Z_j.
 All inputs are IM and vanish off the compact E_j, and all maps are Λ_{j+1}-Lipschitz (Λ_j ≤ Λ_{j+1}). By PF:
 - locality: push (n−1) φ_{j+1} Z_j = L_j and homot (n−1) id φ_{j+1} Z_j = K_j (φ_{j+1} = φ_j on E_j);
 - identity and homotopy formula (degree n = (n−1) + 1, F := id, G := φ_j, X := W_j, ∂W_j IM): V_j − W_j − homot (n−1) id φ_j (∂W_j) = ∂H_j;
 - linearity (with (b); all pieces vanish off E_j) and locality: homot (n−1) id φ_j (∂W_0) = E'_0 − K_0 and homot (n−1) id φ_j (∂W_j) = E'_j + K_{j−1} − K_j for j ≥ 1;
 - boundary commutation, linearity and locality: ∂V_0 = Y_0 − L_0 and ∂V_j = Y_j + L_{j−1} − L_j (j ≥ 1);
 - integrality: V_j, H_j, Y_j, E'_j, L_j, K_j are IM.
 Summing over j = 0, …, N (telescoping):
 (S1) Σ_{j≤N}(V_j − W_j − ∂H_j) = Σ_{j≤N}E'_j − K_N, (S2) ∂(Σ_{j≤N}V_j) = Σ_{j≤N}Y_j − L_N.
 Estimates (PF mass bounds; |φ_j(x) − x| = |ψ(x) − x| ≤ √P on E_j since d > 0 there):
 M(V_0) ≤ c₄ⁿM(T), M(V_j) ≤ c₄ⁿ2^{jn}C_G2^{−(j+1)(n+1)}M(T) ≤ c₄ⁿC_G2^{−j}M(T);
 M(H_0) ≤ √P(2c₄)ⁿM(T), M(H_j) ≤ √P(2c₄)ⁿC_G2^{−j}M(T);
 M(Y_0) ≤ c₄^{n−1}M(∂T), M(Y_j) ≤ c₄^{n−1}C_G2^{−2j}M(∂T); M(E'_0) ≤ √P(2c₄)^{n−1}M(∂T), M(E'_j) ≤ √P(2c₄)^{n−1}C_G2^{−2j}M(∂T);
 M(L_N) ≤ Λ_N^{n−1}M(Z_N) ≤ c₄^{n−1}2^{N(n−1)}·4C_G2^{−(N+2)n}M(T) ≤ 4C_Gc₄^{n−1}2^{−N}M(T) → 0, and M(K_N) ≤ √P(2Λ_N)^{n−1}M(Z_N) → 0 likewise.
